## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_Which denominator makes agentic efficiency meaningful?_

## Planned Coverage

- Cost, latency, energy, and resource use across a trajectory
- Retries, search, verification, human intervention, and rework
- Cost per attempt versus cost per acceptable outcome
- Quality–cost frontiers and adaptive resource allocation
- Capacity planning for uncertain trajectory lengths

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to compare agentic designs using outcome-normalized measures rather than token or step counts alone.
